description: This file defines the BankingService interface in a banking application. It declares several method signatures related to customer and account management, such as adding, updating, and deleting customers, retrieving account and transaction details, and performing transfers.

classes.name: BankingService
classes.description: Interface defining banking operations for customer and account management within the system.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all customers.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Adds a new customer with the provided customer details.

methods.name: findByCustomerNumber
methods.description: Finds customer details by customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates existing customer information identified by customer number.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer identified by customer number.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Finds account details by account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Creates a new account for a customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Performs a transfer of funds between accounts.

methods.name: findTransactionsByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves transaction history for a given account number.
